title: Complaint of James Peffley, Et Altera vs. Heritage Presbytery
disposition_detail: The Assembly record reports that case 2006-04 was found out of order. It does not identify an administrative or judicial subtype or decide the merits.
first_summary: The SJC found James Peffley and others’ complaint against Heritage Presbytery out of order. No separate merits opinion was published, and the record gives no reason, challenged action, or relief.
summary: The Assembly record reports that complaint 2006-04 against Heritage Presbytery was found out of order.
